whenToUse: App and product screens on a marketing page, built from live components instead of screenshots.
A feature section whose tabs or scroll position swap the screen inside one phone (DeviceScreens).
A live preview of a page or template at phone, tablet or desktop width.
avoidWhen: Real screenshots or photos of the product — use image or gallery.
Showing a responsive layout to the person building it — resize the real page instead.
a11y: A static frame is role="img" named by label, with its content inert and hidden; without a label it is decorative.
interactive frames keep their content live and focusable and scroll inside; inactive DeviceScreens are inert.
